items.title: File Widerspruch against the Unterhaltsvorschuss decision
items.quote: Er muss innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids bei uns eingehen (Kreisverwaltung Musterhunsrück, Schlossplatz 7, 55469 Musterbach im Hunsrück)
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19.11.2026. The letter itself states a postal letter counts as known/delivered on the 4th day after posting (Aufgabe zur Post) per § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X; counting that 4th day from 19.11.2026 gives Mon 23.11.2026 as deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe). Under § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted, so the one-month period (§ 26 Abs. 1 SGB X / § 188 Abs. 2 BGB) runs from 24.11.2026 and ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). This day is a normal working day in Rheinland-Pfalz (not a weekend or public holiday), so no shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X is needed. The Widerspruch must reach the Kreisverwaltung (not just be sent) by this date.

items.title: Notify the office immediately if the father pays maintenance or if you move
items.quote: Teilen Sie uns bitte sofort mit, wenn er Unterhalt an Sie zahlt oder Sie umziehen.
items.computation: The letter requires immediate notification ('sofort') upon either triggering event (payment by the father or a house move), but states no calendar date or fixed period — the obligation is ongoing and event-triggered, not tied to a specific deadline from the letter's date. No exact due date can be computed; it applies for as long as Unterhaltsvorschuss is paid, whenever either event occurs.

warnings: This is a routine payment notice for Unterhaltsvorschuss (advance child-maintenance), no immediate action is required except the ongoing duty to report if the father pays maintenance or the family moves, and the right to Widerspruch if the decision is disputed.

The IBAN printed in the letterhead (DE54 5605 0180 0008 2004 00) is well-formed (German, bank code 56050180) but this only confirms its format, not that it genuinely belongs to the Kreisverwaltung; this letter does not actually ask you to pay anything, so no payment should be made based on this IBAN.
